text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing our errands, we dressed up and arrived at the party venue for race affiliates.

text_block_list.name: Big-Hearted Man
text_block_list.text:
Career-wise, you're still a rookie Trainer, right?
You're truly doing a wonderful job.
choice_data_list: I'm completely captivated by how she runs

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My, how passionate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Standing by Mejiro Ramonu's side, I enjoy conversing with the guests.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've grown quite accustomed to this glamorous space, spending my time without feeling overly tense, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text:
Forget it, I'll search for it myself!
If it's hailed as a "supreme treasure," it should be easy enough to find anyway—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the distance, a man was shouting loudly.
It seemed he was looking for someone.
choice_data_list: (A supreme treasure... That must be Mejiro Ramonu)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Handing an empty glass to a venue staff member,
I kept my ears open to monitor the situation,
and sure enough—the commotion headed right this way.

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Mejiro Ramonu-dono!
I actually have a matter of some importance to discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if pushing past the other guests, the man forced his way into the circle.

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text:
Why, I'm just showing off our products!
At any rate, let's head inside and discuss the details—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carried by the momentum of his words,
the man boldly steps right up to Mejiro Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Stepping forward, I gently slipped between them.

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who the heck are you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I straightened my back and answered with a smile,
an indescribable silence fell over the room.

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh! Lady Ramonu's!!
Then you must join us too! I assure you won't regretâ
choice_data_list: First, have some water. Everyone's worried about you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Arrogant Man
text_block_list.text: W-Water? What on earth are you talking—gah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The man looked around and caught his breath,
seemingly noticing the tense atmosphere surrounding him.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without a word, she smoothly extended her hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though surprised inside, I offer my arm to her.
Then, I turned my gaze toward the surrounding guests.
choice_data_list: I'm going to step out for some fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Big-Hearted Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't mind me at all.
Please, take your time.

text_block_list.name: Big-Hearted Man
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, well, what magnificent composure.
Truly worthy of Lady Ramonu's trainer."

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
Just look at the two of them chatting--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The voices of the crowd fade into the distance, and Mejiro Ramonu quietly lets go of my hand.
And then—
choice_data_list: Lay the handkerchief on the bench

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly knelt at Mejiro Ramonu's feet and placed a hand by her ankle.
Surely, the reason she asked to be escorted was...
choice_data_list: Did your new shoes not fit right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
You noticed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The toes are a bit tight.
I'll have them adjusted once I get back.
choice_data_list: I'll bring a spare pair of shoes

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I brought it.
Just as I was about to stand up... a single flower was gently placed in my breast pocket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: âRanunculus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It is beautiful... exceptionally so tonight.

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them talk like that—
...it's just like watching a movie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spreading a handkerchief over the bench,
Mejiro Ramonu sat down with leisure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems I had provided adequate follow-up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why are you standing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why don't you have a seat next to me?

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them talk like that—
...it's just like watching a movie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I breathe a sigh of relief and relax my shoulders.
...I'm glad we managed to get through that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Noticing Mejiro Ramonu's gaze, I straightened my posture once more... and just then,

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: âRusalka, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I feel like dancing a little.
Would you do me the honor of being my partner?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems music she liked was playing.
Taking a deep breath, I take her hand with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them talk like that—
...it's just like watching a movie.
